description: This file defines the Variances class with static methods for calculating different types of variance (VAR, VARA, VARP, VARPA) in a spreadsheet calculation context, including handling of errors and various data types.

classes.name: Variances
classes.description: Class providing static methods to calculate various types of variance in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: VAR
methods.description: Estimates variance based on a sample, excluding non-numeric values.

methods.name: VARA
methods.description: Estimates variance based on a sample, including numbers, text, and logical values.

methods.name: VARP
methods.description: Calculates variance based on the entire population, excluding non-numeric values.

methods.name: VARPA
methods.description: Calculates variance based on the entire population, including numbers, text, and logical values.
